# QYL0702: Batch export disabled

<!-- <auto-generated /> This file is generated by tools/Qyl.OpenTelemetry.SemanticConventions.Analyzers.DocsGenerator. -->

| Analyzer | `Qyl0702BatchExportDisabledAnalyzer` |
| Enabled by default | Yes |

## Description

SimpleSpanProcessor and SimpleActivityExportProcessor export each span immediately as it completes, which incurs significant overhead. BatchSpanProcessor and BatchActivityExportProcessor collect spans and export them in batches, reducing network overhead and improving application performance. Use batch processors in production environments.
